# Pipeline overview {#sec-pipeline}

The backend is built as a pipeline. Each stage receives one object, and returns
a new object of a different type. The stages are connected by the `compiler`
module, and by nothing else.

## The stages {.unnumbered}

```
QuantumCircuit + backend
        │
        ▼
[provider]   detect(backend)              ──► BackendInfo
        │
        ▼
[transpiler] transpile(info, backend, qc) ──► TranspiledCircuit
        │
        ▼
[translator] Translator.translate(...)    ──► NativeCircuit
        │
        ▼
[simulator]  simulate(native)             ──► SimulatedCircuit
        │
        ▼
[vectorizer] vectorize(simulated)         ──► VectorizedCircuit
        │
        ▼
[metrics]    measure(vectorized, info)    ──► MeasuredCircuit
        │
        ▼
[formatter]  format(measured)             ──► dict
        │
        ▼
[exporter]   export(data)                 ──► str (JSON)
```

## What each stage does {.unnumbered}

| Stage | Input | Output | Short description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| provider | a backend object | `BackendInfo` | The provider, the entangler and the noise profile are found. |
| transpiler | circuit and backend | `TranspiledCircuit` | The circuit is changed into the gates of the backend. |
| translator | `TranspiledCircuit` | `NativeCircuit` | Only `gpi`, `gpi2`, `ms` or `zz`, and `virtualz` are kept. |
| simulator | `NativeCircuit` | `SimulatedCircuit` | The state of each qubit is computed after each gate. |
| vectorizer | `SimulatedCircuit` | `VectorizedCircuit` | Angles are changed into `(x, y, z)` vectors. |
| metrics | `VectorizedCircuit` | `MeasuredCircuit` | Fidelities, inactivity, vibration and cost are added. |
| formatter | `MeasuredCircuit` | `dict` | The dictionary of the JSON contract is built. |
| exporter | `dict` | `str` | The dictionary is written as JSON. |

## Two rules that concern every module {.unnumbered}

Two rules are respected by all the modules of the pipeline.

1. **No module imports another pipeline module.** A module may import only
   `core.model`, `core.errors`, `core.config` and, when needed, `core.provider`.
   Only `compiler` knows all the other modules. This keeps the modules easy to
   test and to change.
2. **The public functions are pure.** An object is received, and a new object is
   returned. The input is never changed. There is no global state. There are no
   `print` calls inside `backend/core`; the `logging` module is used instead.

There is one documented exception. The `transpiler` and `tomography` modules are
allowed to call `backend.run`, because a real measurement is needed. The rule of
"one job per run" is respected.

## Where the data types are defined {.unnumbered}

Every object that travels between the stages is defined as a frozen dataclass in
`backend/core/model.py`. A frozen dataclass cannot be changed after it is
created, so the purity rule is easy to keep. The types are documented on the
[Data model](../modules/model.qmd) page.
